text: Most of the week's behaviour changes were fixes in BCApps. In VAT and finance, #13085 and #12982 correct the VAT product posting group regression seen since 28.4, #12813 fixes GB reverse charge sales posting, #11998 blocks posting with a missing General Posting Setup combination, and #13107 adds schema and integrity checks to the CZ ARES lookup. In supply chain, #12842 fixes false "Nothing to handle" pick failures, #12541 keeps the unit of measure when Direct Transfer is toggled, #12868 addresses a rounding variance in Adjust Cost, and #12690 stops a serial number error when reversing capacity entries. Subscription Billing got #12967, #12767 and #10444 for credit memo, rollback and notice period problems. Subcontracting fixes include #12783, #12584 and #11665. New features include credit memo recognition from PDFs in E-Documents (#12855) and the Payables Agent (#12894), and Expense Agent alternate approvers (#11955) and enforced itemization (#12599). French localization moved into separate apps through #13054, #9143 and #9104, while #12160 moves French accelerated depreciation into the W1 base application. AL-Go added protectedSettings (#2293), GitHub Enterprise Cloud data residency support (#2407) and a built-in Copilot review (#2402). BCQuality added many knowledge articles. In BCApps, #10384 opens Subscription Billing procedures for custom usage data connectors.

issues: #12160 is listed as moving French localization into a separate app. It actually moves French accelerated depreciation into the W1 base application; only #13054, #9143 and #9104 move French features into separate apps.
#10384 comes straight after the BCQuality clause, joined by 'and', so it reads like a BCQuality change. It is a BCApps pull request.
